description:

This is an advanced machining position responsible for taking components from technical print through machine setup and first-piece production. The successful candidate will perform complex CNC setups, create and modify programs, select appropriate tooling, interpret inspection results, and make the necessary adjustments to consistently produce components within specification.
This position is ideal for an experienced machinist who is comfortable working independently, troubleshooting complex machining issues, and collaborating with engineering, production, programming, and quality personnel.

• Read and interpret technical blueprints, drawings, specifications, and design models
• Perform complex CNC machine setups from print through first-piece production

• Program and set up CNC machining equipment for new and existing components
• Select, install, and properly configure cutting tools for machining operations
• Adjust machine settings, tooling, offsets, and programs to maintain required specifications
• Interpret CMM inspection results and make appropriate machining adjustments
• Complete first-piece inspections and required quality documentation
• Build and modify basic fixtures and workholding solutions for production
• Establish efficient machine setups and material flow

• Assist with optimizing CNC programs, tooling, cycle times, and machining processes

• CNC programming and program optimization
• Complex CNC machine setup

• CMM inspection and result interpretation
